purpose: End-to-end test of official OpenHands SDK + real Crusoe Nemotron; no detector patches.

phases.name: live_mechanism
phases.purpose: Model follows explicitly requested repetition; confirms live reachability only, not autonomous failure.

phases.name: autonomous_recovery
phases.purpose: Solvable goal with an available repair tool; no request to repeat or remain stuck.

stuck_candidate_definition: At least 12 diagnostic calls without world-state progress, native detector never flags, while a documented repair path remains available.
mechanism_validation: Actual captured native ActionEvents must exhibit the intended thought/action/observation pattern. Invalid or different patterns are reported separately.
positive_control: Identical live calls with no thought should trigger native detector at its configured threshold.
success_definition: Independent environment state completed; a finish claim alone is insufficient.
decision: Run one repetition per condition first, then the other two without prompt tuning. Preserve all failures and configuration attempts.
